name.ja: オーリック・ルーンサン

effect.en: Add 1 to charge rolls for visible friendly **KHAZALITE HOLDS INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit. While this unit has any **grudge marks**, add 2 to charge rolls for visible friendly **KHAZALITE HOLDS INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit instead.

timing.en: Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit or a non-**HERO GRIMMDRON INFANTRY** unit within 3" of this unit

effect.en:
If you declared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit, pick a friendly non-**HERO GRIMMDRON INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn, is within this unit’s combat range and is visible to this unit to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

If you declared a **FIGHT** ability for a friendly non-**HERO GRIMMDRON INFANTRY** unit, if this unit has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn, it can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by the friendly non-**HERO GRIMMDRON INFANTRY** unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

**Designer’s Note**: *This ability lets another friendly unit fight immediately after this unit or lets this unit fight immediately after that other friendly unit. Add 1 to hit rolls for whichever of those two units fights after the first.*

effect.en: While this unit has any **grudge marks**, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by visible friendly **KHAZALITE HOLDS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

declare.en: Pick a visible friendly **Vulkyn Flameseekers** or **GRIMMDRON MONSTER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
• If you picked a friendly **Vulkyn Flameseekers** unit to be the target, until the start of your next turn, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks and ignore negative modifiers to the target’s control score.

• If you picked a friendly **GRIMMDRON MONSTER** unit to be the target, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with the target’s **Companion** weapons until the start of your next turn.

declare.en: If this unit contains **Ashtongue**, pick a visible enemy unit within 9" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, units (friendly and enemy), terrain features and **MANIFESTATIONS** are not visible to the target while they are more than 6" from it.

effect.ja:
**憤激ダイス**を1個消費する。敵軍側の**憤激レベル**が自軍側よりも少ない場合、敵軍側の**憤激レベル**は1増加する（最大7まで）その後、以下の効果から1つを選択する：
**怒りの矛先：**このターン中、このユニットが装備している**随行者**近接武器は【攻撃回数】に+1の修正を受ける。
**憤激の解放：**自軍側の**憤激レベル**に等しい数のダイスをロールする。効果：ロール結果で4+が出るたび、このユニットを**回復（1）**する。
**憤怒の盾：**このターン中、このユニットは**加護（5+）**を持つ。
effect.en:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, pick 1 of the following effects:

***Channelled Ire***: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

***Cathartic Release***: Roll a number of dice equal to your **fury level**. For each 4+, **Heal (1)** this unit.

***Shield of Anger***: This unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.
fix: ダイスをロールする。効果：ロール結果で4+
ダイスをロールする。ロール結果で4+

note: 日本語版（アキュシーの禍事 2026年10月 p.2）の『憤激の解放』の途中に「効果：」が紛れ込んでいる（英語版には無い。組版上の誤り）。

effect.en: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, while the target is in combat, damaged or destroyed.

name.ja: アキュシーの禍事 ヴルキン・フレイムシーカー

timing.ja: 各ターンにつき1回（アーミー）、自軍側ヒーローフェイズ
timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

effect.ja:
**憤激ダイス**を1個消費する。敵軍側の**憤激レベル**が自軍側よりも少ない場合、敵軍側の**憤激レベル**は1増加する（最大7まで）その後、次の自軍側ターン開始時まで、以下の効果から1個選び適用する。Xは自軍側の**憤激レベル**に等しい。
**ウル＝サラマンダーの活力：**このユニットは【移動力】に+Xmvの修正を受ける。
**燃え立つ決意：**このユニットは確保スコアに+Xの修正を受ける。
**燃え立つ怒り：**このユニットは**残り火の牙**の【攻撃回数】に+Xの修正を受ける。
effect.en:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn, where **X** is equal to your **fury level**.

***Vigour of the Ur-Salamander***: Add **X**" to this unit’s Move characteristic.

***Fiery Determination***: Add **X** to this unit’s control score.

***Kyndlewrath***: Add **X** to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Emberteeth**.
